meta.title: Shining Through The Tide
meta.description: Even as the tide washes in, a lantern remains. Imbue it with your wisdom and ignite a new light.

units.rawText: Several minutes ago, at the main energy tower in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Several minutes ago, at the main energy tower in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Several minutes ago, at the main energy tower in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning: Entropic signal detected. Warning: Large number of Entropic signals detected. Warning, superlative amount of Entropics detected; please carefully consider your combat approach...</color>
units.displayText: Warning: Entropic signal detected. Warning: Large number of Entropic signals detected. Warning, superlative amount of Entropics detected; please carefully consider your combat approach...

spans.text: Warning: Entropic signal detected. Warning: Large number of Entropic signals detected. Warning, superlative amount of Entropics detected; please carefully consider your combat approach...

units.rawText: Oh shut up.
units.displayText: Oh shut up.

spans.text: Oh shut up.

units.rawText: Alcyone shoots down an Entropic trying to attack her from above and disables the system alerts at the same time.
units.displayText: Alcyone shoots down an Entropic trying to attack her from above and disables the system alerts at the same time.

spans.text: Alcyone shoots down an Entropic trying to attack her from above and disables the system alerts at the same time.

units.rawText: Is there no end to these Daemons...
units.displayText: Is there no end to these Daemons...

spans.text: Is there no end to these Daemons...

units.rawText: It isn't just their numbers... These Entropics are much stronger than the Low-Orders we met before. It's taking almost twice the amount of attack power to defeat them.
units.displayText: It isn't just their numbers... These Entropics are much stronger than the Low-Orders we met before. It's taking almost twice the amount of attack power to defeat them.

spans.text: It isn't just their numbers... These Entropics are much stronger than the Low-Orders we met before. It's taking almost twice the amount of attack power to defeat them.

units.rawText: As she sees a wounded Low-Order Entropic crawling toward her, Electra blocks a spray of Liquid Entropy with her twin blades, then retreats behind Alcyone to defend her blind spot.
units.displayText: As she sees a wounded Low-Order Entropic crawling toward her, Electra blocks a spray of Liquid Entropy with her twin blades, then retreats behind Alcyone to defend her blind spot.

spans.text: As she sees a wounded Low-Order Entropic crawling toward her, Electra blocks a spray of Liquid Entropy with her twin blades, then retreats behind Alcyone to defend her blind spot.

units.rawText: Their original route of egress is swamped with Entropics, and the two of them are forced to mount a fighting retreat.
units.displayText: Their original route of egress is swamped with Entropics, and the two of them are forced to mount a fighting retreat.

spans.text: Their original route of egress is swamped with Entropics, and the two of them are forced to mount a fighting retreat.

units.rawText: Ally, our operand expenditures are growing but those Entropics aren't showing any sign of weakening or retreating. Looks like these Daemons plan to trap us in this area.
units.displayText: Ally, our operand expenditures are growing but those Entropics aren't showing any sign of weakening or retreating. Looks like these Daemons plan to trap us in this area.

spans.text: Ally, our operand expenditures are growing but those Entropics aren't showing any sign of weakening or retreating. Looks like these Daemons plan to trap us in this area.

units.rawText: Perhaps the Spoof Code failing or the shifting of the labyrinth was all part of their plan. If we withdraw under these circumstances...
units.displayText: Perhaps the Spoof Code failing or the shifting of the labyrinth was all part of their plan. If we withdraw under these circumstances...

spans.text: Perhaps the Spoof Code failing or the shifting of the labyrinth was all part of their plan. If we withdraw under these circumstances...

units.rawText: <size=28>How dare they disgrace us like this...</size>
units.displayText: How dare they disgrace us like this...

spans.text: How dare they disgrace us like this...

units.rawText: Electra, we're Greater Sanctifiers!
units.displayText: Electra, we're Greater Sanctifiers!

spans.text: Electra, we're Greater Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: ...Ally?
units.displayText: ...Ally?

spans.text: ...Ally?

units.rawText: Alcyone does not look away; instead, she draws her bow again—
units.displayText: Alcyone does not look away; instead, she draws her bow again—

spans.text: Alcyone does not look away; instead, she draws her bow again—

units.rawText: Whoosh!
units.displayText: Whoosh!

spans.text: Whoosh!

units.rawText: An arrow streaks through the air, clearing a golden path through the Entropic horde.
units.displayText: An arrow streaks through the air, clearing a golden path through the Entropic horde.

spans.text: An arrow streaks through the air, clearing a golden path through the Entropic horde.

units.rawText: ...You think mere Low-Order Entropics like you can confine a Greater Sanctifier?!
units.displayText: ...You think mere Low-Order Entropics like you can confine a Greater Sanctifier?!

spans.text: ...You think mere Low-Order Entropics like you can confine a Greater Sanctifier?!

units.rawText: I was afraid that being too showy would draw too much attention and make things harder for the other two groups... But right now, it seems there is no need for stealth.
units.displayText: I was afraid that being too showy would draw too much attention and make things harder for the other two groups... But right now, it seems there is no need for stealth.

spans.text: I was afraid that being too showy would draw too much attention and make things harder for the other two groups... But right now, it seems there is no need for stealth.

units.rawText: Alcyone launches herself off the ground with the tips of her toes and soars to a high place.
units.displayText: Alcyone launches herself off the ground with the tips of her toes and soars to a high place.

spans.text: Alcyone launches herself off the ground with the tips of her toes and soars to a high place.

units.rawText: Foolish Daemons! I shall pass judgment upon you!
units.displayText: Foolish Daemons! I shall pass judgment upon you!

spans.text: Foolish Daemons! I shall pass judgment upon you!

units.rawText: As she finishes speaking, Alcyone's body shines brightly and within a formless barrier, golden light gathers at the tip of her arrow's head.
units.displayText: As she finishes speaking, Alcyone's body shines brightly and within a formless barrier, golden light gathers at the tip of her arrow's head.

spans.text: As she finishes speaking, Alcyone's body shines brightly and within a formless barrier, golden light gathers at the tip of her arrow's head.

units.rawText: Electra, since they don't plan to let us retreat, let's stick to the plan and blow up the energy tower.
units.displayText: Electra, since they don't plan to let us retreat, let's stick to the plan and blow up the energy tower.

spans.text: Electra, since they don't plan to let us retreat, let's stick to the plan and blow up the energy tower.

units.rawText: I'm going to destroy those Daemons and that disgusting tower of theirs!
units.displayText: I'm going to destroy those Daemons and that disgusting tower of theirs!

spans.text: I'm going to destroy those Daemons and that disgusting tower of theirs!

units.rawText: Ally...
units.displayText: Ally...

spans.text: Ally...

units.rawText: I'm too far away right now, so I need more time to charge up. Help me buy some time, Electra!
units.displayText: I'm too far away right now, so I need more time to charge up. Help me buy some time, Electra!

spans.text: I'm too far away right now, so I need more time to charge up. Help me buy some time, Electra!

units.rawText: ...Humph, indeed...
units.displayText: ...Humph, indeed...

spans.text: ...Humph, indeed...

units.rawText: Electra smiles as she feels Alcyone's determination. Her twin blades flash, easily cutting several Low-Order Entropics to pieces.
units.displayText: Electra smiles as she feels Alcyone's determination. Her twin blades flash, easily cutting several Low-Order Entropics to pieces.

spans.text: Electra smiles as she feels Alcyone's determination. Her twin blades flash, easily cutting several Low-Order Entropics to pieces.

units.rawText: Well, if these Daemons are bold enough to ambush us Greater Sanctifiers, then we'll show them our might. I'll cover you!
units.displayText: Well, if these Daemons are bold enough to ambush us Greater Sanctifiers, then we'll show them our might. I'll cover you!

spans.text: Well, if these Daemons are bold enough to ambush us Greater Sanctifiers, then we'll show them our might. I'll cover you!

units.rawText: The Low-Order Entropics seem to sense the power gathering in Alcyone's hands and go around Electra, charging straight at Alcyone. However, no matter how they try and rush her, they are cut to pieces by Electra's flashing blades.
units.displayText: The Low-Order Entropics seem to sense the power gathering in Alcyone's hands and go around Electra, charging straight at Alcyone. However, no matter how they try and rush her, they are cut to pieces by Electra's flashing blades.

spans.text: The Low-Order Entropics seem to sense the power gathering in Alcyone's hands and go around Electra, charging straight at Alcyone. However, no matter how they try and rush her, they are cut to pieces by Electra's flashing blades.

units.rawText: Who gave you permission to approach Ally, Daemon?
units.displayText: Who gave you permission to approach Ally, Daemon?

spans.text: Who gave you permission to approach Ally, Daemon?

units.rawText: Electra's blades cut into a Low-Order Entropic's body, but then she felt something had grazed her shoulder.
units.displayText: Electra's blades cut into a Low-Order Entropic's body, but then she felt something had grazed her shoulder.

spans.text: Electra's blades cut into a Low-Order Entropic's body, but then she felt something had grazed her shoulder.

units.rawText: (I guess it's still quite draining after all... This isn't right, these Low-Order Entropics aren't any different from the ones we met earlier, so how did they get so strong all of a sudden?)
units.displayText: I guess it's still quite draining after all... This isn't right, these Low-Order Entropics aren't any different from the ones we met earlier, so how did they get so strong all of a sudden?

spans.text: I guess it's still quite draining after all... This isn't right, these Low-Order Entropics aren't any different from the ones we met earlier, so how did they get so strong all of a sudden?

units.rawText: (Whatever the reason, I need to keep Ally safe...)
units.displayText: Whatever the reason, I need to keep Ally safe...

spans.text: Whatever the reason, I need to keep Ally safe...

units.rawText: Electra looks up at Alcyone, who's charging up a shot in mid-air, but then she sees a blade flashing behind her.
units.displayText: Electra looks up at Alcyone, who's charging up a shot in mid-air, but then she sees a blade flashing behind her.

spans.text: Electra looks up at Alcyone, who's charging up a shot in mid-air, but then she sees a blade flashing behind her.

units.rawText: Electra, I'm counting down to the release of the Judgement Arrow...
units.displayText: Electra, I'm counting down to the release of the Judgement Arrow...

spans.text: Electra, I'm counting down to the release of the Judgement Arrow...

units.rawText: <size=40>ALCYONE! DUCK!</size>
units.displayText: ALCYONE! DUCK!

spans.text: ALCYONE! DUCK!

units.rawText: Electra runs up, missing the red figure flashing past her in the blind spot of her vision.
units.displayText: Electra runs up, missing the red figure flashing past her in the blind spot of her vision.

spans.text: Electra runs up, missing the red figure flashing past her in the blind spot of her vision.

units.rawText: Over here, Big Sis.
units.displayText: Over here, Big Sis.

spans.text: Over here, Big Sis.

units.rawText: What...
units.displayText: What...

spans.text: What...

units.rawText: Electra reflexively dodges to the right, yet, a black longsword pierces through her abdomen from behind.
units.displayText: Electra reflexively dodges to the right, yet, a black longsword pierces through her abdomen from behind.

spans.text: Electra reflexively dodges to the right, yet, a black longsword pierces through her abdomen from behind.

units.rawText: Urgh... aaaaahhhhh!
units.displayText: Urgh... aaaaahhhhh!

spans.text: Urgh... aaaaahhhhh!

units.rawText: <size=40>ELECTRA!!</size>
units.displayText: ELECTRA!!

spans.text: ELECTRA!!

units.rawText: A High-Order Entropic in red steps out from behind Electra, hoisting her body high on her longsword.
units.displayText: A High-Order Entropic in red steps out from behind Electra, hoisting her body high on her longsword.

spans.text: A High-Order Entropic in red steps out from behind Electra, hoisting her body high on her longsword.

units.rawText: Guess you couldn't dodge it after all. This wasn't as fun as I hoped it would be.
units.displayText: Guess you couldn't dodge it after all. This wasn't as fun as I hoped it would be.

spans.text: Guess you couldn't dodge it after all. This wasn't as fun as I hoped it would be.

units.rawText: Dammit...
units.displayText: Dammit...

spans.text: Dammit...

units.rawText: Alcyone turns and draws a bead on the High-Order Entropic, but she doesn't dare to let loose her shot. The High Order Entropic uses Electra as a shield; if she fires her charged shot, Electra will definitely get caught up in it.
units.displayText: Alcyone turns and draws a bead on the High-Order Entropic, but she doesn't dare to let loose her shot. The High Order Entropic uses Electra as a shield; if she fires her charged shot, Electra will definitely get caught up in it.

spans.text: Alcyone turns and draws a bead on the High-Order Entropic, but she doesn't dare to let loose her shot. The High Order Entropic uses Electra as a shield; if she fires her charged shot, Electra will definitely get caught up in it.

units.rawText: Forget about me! Just sh—cough!
units.displayText: Forget about me! Just sh—cough!

spans.text: Forget about me! Just sh—cough!

units.rawText: The crimson High-Order Entropic pins Electra's twin knives with just one hand and the other tightens around her throat.
units.displayText: The crimson High-Order Entropic pins Electra's twin knives with just one hand and the other tightens around her throat.

spans.text: The crimson High-Order Entropic pins Electra's twin knives with just one hand and the other tightens around her throat.

units.rawText: Hahahaha! Hey, is that all you Sanctifiers have?
units.displayText: Hahahaha! Hey, is that all you Sanctifiers have?

spans.text: Hahahaha! Hey, is that all you Sanctifiers have?

units.rawText: Ugh... What is this strength...
units.displayText: Ugh... What is this strength...

spans.text: Ugh... What is this strength...

units.rawText: Come on, let's enjoy this battle someplace else!
units.displayText: Come on, let's enjoy this battle someplace else!

spans.text: Come on, let's enjoy this battle someplace else!

units.rawText: The crimson High-Order Entropic leaps into the Entropic horde with Electra in hand and vanishes among them.
units.displayText: The crimson High-Order Entropic leaps into the Entropic horde with Electra in hand and vanishes among them.

spans.text: The crimson High-Order Entropic leaps into the Entropic horde with Electra in hand and vanishes among them.

units.rawText: ELECTRA!!!
units.displayText: ELECTRA!!!

spans.text: ELECTRA!!!

units.rawText: The High-Order Entropic maintains a grip tight as a vise around Electra's neck while dragging her through the other Entropics. Electra tries to fight through the pain and swing her blades, but every strike she attempts is blocked.
units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic maintains a grip tight as a vise around Electra's neck while dragging her through the other Entropics. Electra tries to fight through the pain and swing her blades, but every strike she attempts is blocked.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic maintains a grip tight as a vise around Electra's neck while dragging her through the other Entropics. Electra tries to fight through the pain and swing her blades, but every strike she attempts is blocked.

units.rawText: Let... go...
units.displayText: Let... go...

spans.text: Let... go...

units.rawText: This should do! Hah!
units.displayText: This should do! Hah!

spans.text: This should do! Hah!

units.rawText: (Coughs) Damn Daemon...
units.displayText: (Coughs) Damn Daemon...

spans.text: (Coughs) Damn Daemon...

units.rawText: The Entropic slams Electra into the wall of the labyrinth. The massive impact sends pain coursing through Electra's body.
units.displayText: The Entropic slams Electra into the wall of the labyrinth. The massive impact sends pain coursing through Electra's body.

spans.text: The Entropic slams Electra into the wall of the labyrinth. The massive impact sends pain coursing through Electra's body.

units.rawText: (This fearsome strength... Could it be even greater than Atlas? But now I have an angle to...)
units.displayText: This fearsome strength... Could it be even greater than Atlas? But now I have an angle to...

spans.text: This fearsome strength... Could it be even greater than Atlas? But now I have an angle to...

units.rawText: Boom!
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: What... <size=40><color=red>GWAAAAARGH!</color></size>
units.displayText: What... GWAAAAARGH!

spans.text: What...
GWAAAAARGH!

units.rawText: An ominous purple spreads from the High-Order Entropic's palm and explodes inside Electra's body.
units.displayText: An ominous purple spreads from the High-Order Entropic's palm and explodes inside Electra's body.

spans.text: An ominous purple spreads from the High-Order Entropic's palm and explodes inside Electra's body.

units.rawText: Warning, system structure damage at 50%. Warning, basic power transmission programs offline. Warning, system turbulence...
units.displayText: Warning, system structure damage at 50%. Warning, basic power transmission programs offline. Warning, system turbulence...

spans.text: Warning, system structure damage at 50%. Warning, basic power transmission programs offline. Warning, system turbulence...

units.rawText: Argh... (cough) D-damn you...
units.displayText: Argh... (cough) D-damn you...

spans.text: Argh... (cough) D-damn you...

units.rawText: Hah? Is that it? No way... Then what difference is there between you and those Intermediates?!
units.displayText: Hah? Is that it? No way... Then what difference is there between you and those Intermediates?!

spans.text: Hah? Is that it? No way... Then what difference is there between you and those Intermediates?!

units.rawText: If I'd known, I'd have gone after that shrimp instead.
units.displayText: If I'd known, I'd have gone after that shrimp instead.

spans.text: If I'd known, I'd have gone after that shrimp instead.

units.rawText: I won't... I won't let you lay a hand on Alcyone!
units.displayText: I won't... I won't let you lay a hand on Alcyone!

spans.text: I won't... I won't let you lay a hand on Alcyone!

units.rawText: Ohhhh! I LIKE those eyes! Let's continue, then... Yeeart!
units.displayText: Ohhhh! I LIKE those eyes! Let's continue, then... Yeeart!

spans.text: Ohhhh! I LIKE those eyes! Let's continue, then... Yeeart!

units.rawText: <size=40>ELECTRA!!</size>
units.displayText: ELECTRA!!

spans.text: ELECTRA!!

units.rawText: The crimson High-Order Entropic evades her attack. Alcyone uses this opportunity to swoop in low and take Electra back from her.
units.displayText: The crimson High-Order Entropic evades her attack. Alcyone uses this opportunity to swoop in low and take Electra back from her.

spans.text: The crimson High-Order Entropic evades her attack. Alcyone uses this opportunity to swoop in low and take Electra back from her.

units.rawText: Electra, wake up!
units.displayText: Electra, wake up!

spans.text: Electra, wake up!

units.rawText: Urgh... run away...
units.displayText: Urgh... run away...

spans.text: Urgh... run away...

units.rawText: Uwah, that was close.
units.displayText: Uwah, that was close.

spans.text: Uwah, that was close.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, you're pretty fast, shrimpy! And here I was worried that it'd be too boring!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, you're pretty fast, shrimpy! And here I was worried that it'd be too boring!

spans.text: Hahahaha, you're pretty fast, shrimpy! And here I was worried that it'd be too boring!

units.rawText: The High-Order Entropic plucks the golden arrow out from where it's stuck in the wall nearby and snaps it in half.
units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic plucks the golden arrow out from where it's stuck in the wall nearby and snaps it in half.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic plucks the golden arrow out from where it's stuck in the wall nearby and snaps it in half.

units.rawText: I'll play with you next!
units.displayText: I'll play with you next!

spans.text: I'll play with you next!

units.rawText: <size=40>YOU BITCH!!!!</size>
units.displayText: YOU BITCH!!!!

spans.text: YOU BITCH!!!!

units.rawText: Alcyone grits her teeth and looks at the nearly comatose Electra, and then glares at the crimson High-Order Entropic in front of her.
units.displayText: Alcyone grits her teeth and looks at the nearly comatose Electra, and then glares at the crimson High-Order Entropic in front of her.

spans.text: Alcyone grits her teeth and looks at the nearly comatose Electra, and then glares at the crimson High-Order Entropic in front of her.

units.rawText: You'll pay for this, Daemon!
units.displayText: You'll pay for this, Daemon!

spans.text: You'll pay for this, Daemon!

units.rawText: Alcyone draws her bow and quickly fires off an arrow of light.
units.displayText: Alcyone draws her bow and quickly fires off an arrow of light.

spans.text: Alcyone draws her bow and quickly fires off an arrow of light.

units.rawText: Gahahahah! Bring it!
units.displayText: Gahahahah! Bring it!

spans.text: Gahahahah! Bring it!

units.rawText: The High-Order Entropic swings her longsword at the light arrow.
units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic swings her longsword at the light arrow.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic swings her longsword at the light arrow.

units.rawText: Huh? The arrow split... Uwah!
units.displayText: Huh? The arrow split... Uwah!

spans.text: Huh? The arrow split... Uwah!

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily) Where did all this smoke come from... damn brat...
units.displayText: (Coughs heavily) Where did all this smoke come from... damn brat...

spans.text: (Coughs heavily) Where did all this smoke come from... damn brat...

units.rawText: She's gone! Where the hell did they go to?!
units.displayText: She's gone! Where the hell did they go to?!

spans.text: She's gone! Where the hell did they go to?!

units.rawText: Her vision obscured by the smoke, the High-Order Entropic slashes at it to drive it away.
units.displayText: Her vision obscured by the smoke, the High-Order Entropic slashes at it to drive it away.

spans.text: Her vision obscured by the smoke, the High-Order Entropic slashes at it to drive it away.

units.rawText: Goddammit! She tricked me, that damn shrimp!
units.displayText: Goddammit! She tricked me, that damn shrimp!

spans.text: Goddammit! She tricked me, that damn shrimp!

units.rawText: ...Never mind, I'll find you soon enough...
units.displayText: ...Never mind, I'll find you soon enough...

spans.text: ...Never mind, I'll find you soon enough...

units.rawText:
A golden arrow streaks through the darkened sky of Tartarus.
Alcyone puts her bow away and scoops Electra's heavily-wounded body up in her little arms as she surveys her surroundings.
units.displayText:
A golden arrow streaks through the darkened sky of Tartarus.
Alcyone puts her bow away and scoops Electra's heavily-wounded body up in her little arms as she surveys her surroundings.

spans.text:
A golden arrow streaks through the darkened sky of Tartarus.
Alcyone puts her bow away and scoops Electra's heavily-wounded body up in her little arms as she surveys her surroundings.

units.rawText: They should be here soon... Electra? Electra! What happened to you?
units.displayText: They should be here soon... Electra? Electra! What happened to you?

spans.text: They should be here soon... Electra? Electra! What happened to you?

units.rawText: Fundamental structure damage, lowered neural cloud stability... dammit...
units.displayText: Fundamental structure damage, lowered neural cloud stability... dammit...

spans.text: Fundamental structure damage, lowered neural cloud stability... dammit...

units.rawText: The labyrinth's walls are high and impassable. In this unfamiliar terrain, Alcyone uses her instincts to sense a safe place while slowly infusing golden operands into Electra's body.
units.displayText: The labyrinth's walls are high and impassable. In this unfamiliar terrain, Alcyone uses her instincts to sense a safe place while slowly infusing golden operands into Electra's body.

spans.text: The labyrinth's walls are high and impassable. In this unfamiliar terrain, Alcyone uses her instincts to sense a safe place while slowly infusing golden operands into Electra's body.

units.rawText: If only I had just fired with my arrow... No, wait, what was that High-Order Entropic even doing here?
units.displayText: If only I had just fired with my arrow... No, wait, what was that High-Order Entropic even doing here?

spans.text: If only I had just fired with my arrow... No, wait, what was that High-Order Entropic even doing here?

units.rawText: Was my judgment off? No... It can't be. We only detected Low-Order Entropics back then.
units.displayText: Was my judgment off? No... It can't be. We only detected Low-Order Entropics back then.

spans.text: Was my judgment off? No... It can't be. We only detected Low-Order Entropics back then.

units.rawText: ...Or was this a trap from the start?
units.displayText: ...Or was this a trap from the start?

spans.text: ...Or was this a trap from the start?

units.rawText: Ally...
units.displayText: Ally...

spans.text: Ally...

units.rawText: Electra! You're awake!
units.displayText: Electra! You're awake!

spans.text: Electra! You're awake!

units.rawText: (Coughs) I'm okay...
units.displayText: (Coughs) I'm okay...

spans.text: (Coughs) I'm okay...

units.rawText: What do you mean "you're okay"?! Your body, it's... it's all my fault.
units.displayText: What do you mean "you're okay"?! Your body, it's... it's all my fault.

spans.text: What do you mean "you're okay"?! Your body, it's... it's all my fault.

units.rawText: I should have listened to you, I shouldn't have gone that far in...
units.displayText: I should have listened to you, I shouldn't have gone that far in...

spans.text: I should have listened to you, I shouldn't have gone that far in...

units.rawText: Ally, this isn't your fault. Neither of us could have expected that... these Daemons would be so cunning.
units.displayText: Ally, this isn't your fault. Neither of us could have expected that... these Daemons would be so cunning.

spans.text: Ally, this isn't your fault. Neither of us could have expected that... these Daemons would be so cunning.

units.rawText: But I... I should have sensed it...
units.displayText: But I... I should have sensed it...

spans.text: But I... I should have sensed it...

units.rawText: Everyone makes mistakes, just like I had to clean up after you in the past... And besides, this time we both messed up.
units.displayText: Everyone makes mistakes, just like I had to clean up after you in the past... And besides, this time we both messed up.

spans.text: Everyone makes mistakes, just like I had to clean up after you in the past... And besides, this time we both messed up.

units.rawText: So have some candy and relax... (coughs heavily)
units.displayText: So have some candy and relax... (coughs heavily)

spans.text: So have some candy and relax... (coughs heavily)

units.rawText: Electra! Don't say any more! I'll get you to a safe area soon...
units.displayText: Electra! Don't say any more! I'll get you to a safe area soon...
